context:
# Goal
Tabi round 40, attempt 2. One v2 wave of 64 seats. C1 is the sole amended pre-data frozen claim: coverage capability, round-40 Playwright Firefox loopback TCP evidence with >=8 strictly increasing samples whose actual first-to-last timestamp span is >=1000ms, both ss/proc surfaces available with positive observation ticks on every sample and final sweep, zero observed non-loopback counts, nonempty owned process tree, identical first-shot hashes, no survivors, closed fixture port, and browser version bound. The amended claim/counter/control commit: c451a3c401741e5cc34239e0df63d113d86267e5; it supersedes the first freeze before dispatch/data; round-start baseline: a1b1e939048885d2793759b7f49b10c5c820d70d. Read /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-40/claims.json and the exact amended frozen counter before work; never widen or amend the predicate.

Scope: your reports only under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-40/w1/<SeatName>/report.md. Production tree, fleet, siblings and shokuknow source repo are read-only. No commits/pushes, no git/jj mutation, no agents spawned, no external site interaction. For quarantine seats, read the source register and fetch only your assigned cited public source; do not edit or write anywhere under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow. Every Report trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin: write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>.

Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): may install/upgrade tools that help the task; first read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md (official channels only) and record tool/version/channel/reason. PACMAN GUARD: pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide; never run pacman. No tool install is planned; do not install unless essential.

Scratch root: /fast/scratch/hyaku/tabi-r40/<YourSeatName>/; mkdir -p and pass it explicitly. Delete it before yielding (`trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT` or Python finally). `/tmp` only files under 50 MB; never rely on inherited TMPDIR. Receipts that matter go in your lane report folder. No shared production writers.

One wave item per seat, leaf only. Return one report with exact observed commands/output, evidence paths, limitations, and final `VERDICT ok|finding|could-not-evaluate ...` line. No claim verdict by assertion.
